status: People Payroll now has owner-local native Company payroll summary and run-list reads, an owner-local HTTP router, and a fail-closed Next transport/SSR cutover; shared composition mounting, command writes, run-detail reads, expense/directory/pay-group closure and browser acceptance remain open

scope.workflowBoundary: The posted payroll summary and the scoped run list are the qualified read slice. Payroll run creation/calculation/cancellation/posting, run detail, payslips, expense, leave, directory and pay-group configuration are not claimed.
scope.domain: Payroll read actor policy (Company scope, payroll.read/payroll.payment.read, selected-context expiry), calendar YYYY-MM validation, bounded and validated summary/run row facts.
scope.application: Summary and run-list read use cases. Summary requires payroll.read and rejects branch/department scope. Run list permits payroll.payment.read but returns only posted runs with payment-batch facts and redacted totals; payroll.read returns all Company runs. No silent TypeScript owner-read fallback.
scope.adapters: Own SQL over hr_payroll_runs, hr_payroll_items and the owner's hr_payment_batches join. The caller's serializable Holding transaction is required. No IAM, purchase, Finance or workflow SQL is invented; no owner write is performed.
scope.http: Owner-local GET router for /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/people/payroll/summary (optional payMonth) and /people/payroll/runs. Exact Host/Holding targets, duplicate-query rejection, bounded private/no-store JSON and business-error status mapping. The composition backend receives transport facts only and must supply the normal Account session, current Company scope, purchase admission and serializable owner read.
scope.transport: Fail-closed Next client validates the configured Holding origin, loopback private base, reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101/3103/8080 plus 5432/5433/5435/3200-3299, timeout, cookie/context CAS headers, selected branch/department workspace headers, exact row/context shapes, duplicate keys and bounded bodies.
scope.ssr: The People Payroll dashboard reads summary and runs through the native transport, and the People REST GET summary/runs routes do the same. Unset ERPX_NATIVE_PEOPLE_PAYROLL_CONFIG produces explicit NATIVE_PEOPLE_PAYROLL_UNAVAILABLE 503s; there is no fallback to the replaced TypeScript readers.
scope.purchaseAndIdentity: The retained withPayrollPurchasedRead preflight still checks the Commercial people.payroll capability and current Identity assignment before the native read. This is a preflight, not an atomic owner unit; the composition backend must repeat current authority and admission on its own transaction.
scope.notClaimed: No browser journey, authenticated page render, shared composition mount, command/idempotency receipt, audit/outbox effect, Finance guard, run detail, payslip, expense, directory, pay-group write, jobs or production acceptance.

targets.lib: 3 passed (router target configuration, private headers and actual loopback request/query/error mapping)

cases: posted Company runs aggregate by pay month and currency with actual item totals; draft and foreign Company runs are excluded

payment-only read returns only posted runs, includes the latest non-cancelled payment batch, and redacts totals
payroll.read run list includes preview runs and retains totals; a foreign Company reads only its own source
missing permission, branch/department scope, expired selected context and payment-only summary fail closed
a reader outside a transaction, or inside a non-serializable transaction, fails closed
a posted run inserted inside an owner transaction is visible to the read and disappears after the transaction aborts; committed readback does not create or delete runs

responses carry private/no-store, no-referrer and nosniff headers
duplicate targets and non-HTTPS origins fail configuration
